# Nazam LLC

> AI automation for small businesses, Amazon sellers, and Walmart sellers.

Nazam LLC builds AI chatbots, AI receptionists, seller dashboards, lead follow-up systems, and workflow automation for small businesses, Amazon sellers, and Walmart sellers. The page is optimized around buyer-intent services including AI automation for small business, Amazon seller automation service, AI chatbot for small business, Walmart seller automation, AI receptionist for small business, business workflow automation service, and Amazon reporting dashboard service.

Nazam LLC also shares build stories from its own AI glow-up mobile application work. The website has a visible "Build Stories" hero button near the top of the home page, a "Build Stories" navigation link, a process-section link, and a footer link. All point to https://nazamllc.com/#stories. This section explains how the idea was shaped, how the design moved into Figma, how the screens were turned into code, how daily usage was tested, and how feedback changed the product before launch.

## AI Glow-Up App Build Stories

The Build Stories section is available at https://nazamllc.com/#stories.

Story 01, "Idea to Figma", explains that the app started from a daily user question: "What should I do today?" The concept became a daily glow-up assistant that understands the user's goal, turns it into a realistic routine, and makes progress visible without overwhelming the user. The design decisions include onboarding flow, goal intake, daily plan screen, and progress view.

Story 02, "Design to code", explains how the Figma-style product flow became a testable daily-use loop. The daily path is: open the app, choose a goal, generate a plan, complete the routine, and review progress. This story shows how Nazam LLC thinks through code and product testing from the user's repeated daily behavior.

Story 03, "Feedback changes", explains what changed after another reviewer joined the process. The visible changes were shorter onboarding, cleaner copy, less friction, better progress notes, and a clearer next step for the user.
